messages.text: I have a soy allergy. Probably more frustrating than dangerous but I avoid it strictly.
Got it. I know soy is in a surprisingly large share of processed and Asian food, so I'll check for it specifically.
Recipe for a quick chicken marinade for the grill tonight?

## Teriyaki Chicken Marinade

Whisk together:
- ½ cup soy sauce
- 3 tbsp brown sugar
- 2 tbsp rice vinegar
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 3 cloves grated garlic
- 1 inch grated ginger

Marinate 2 lbs chicken thighs for 30 minutes. Grill on medium-high for 5 minutes per side, basting with leftover marinade. Top with sesame seeds and sliced scallions.
